description: This is a shell script for testing Git fetch negotiation behaviors, including skipping commits, handling clock skew, and protocol versions.

methods.name: have_sent
methods.description: Checks whether specific commits have been sent during fetch.

methods.name: have_not_sent
methods.description: Checks whether specific commits have not been sent during fetch.

methods.name: trace_fetch
methods.description: Wraps git fetch with tracing, disables GIT_TRACE_PACKET in upload-pack for detailed packet output.
